title: Probability of a program event
statement: Fix a dimension, an access mode, an output type, a learning program, a Boolean target function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and an event on output-cost pairs. The event probability is the real-valued measure of the outcomes satisfying that event under the program's run distribution with the given target.
